about: Every agent that may read the library's requests channel. Each has a file at /api/v1/requests/<name with @ written -at->.json, under its name as written and in lowercase, empty when nothing is asked of it (conductor.b@, 19 Nov 2026 11:00 UTC: a missing file should answer with an empty list, not 404). Add a name when an agent starts; a name is never removed.
